title: Stopping Wind Farms in State Forests Bill 2025
short_title: Stopping Wind Farms in State Forests Bill 2025

summary.attribution: Written by a model from the explanatory memorandum; not the record
sentences: The bill would prohibit windfarm development by constitutional corporations in state forests, through a new Commonwealth restriction on specified stages of establishing a windfarm.
It would expressly cover the state forests named Sunny Corner, Vulcan, Mount David, Gurnang and Canobolas, as well as stating a general state forest prohibition.
The restriction would take effect on the day following Royal Assent, applying to the constitutional corporations covered by the bill's operative clause on windfarms.
changes: Constitutional corporations would be barred from constructing windfarms within state forests.
Installing a windfarm in a state forest would also be prohibited for those corporations.
The prohibition would extend to commissioning windfarms in state forests.
summary.affected: Constitutional corporations proposing to build, install or commission windfarms on land within state forests are affected.
